```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  fig.width = 9,
  fig.height = 7,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  dpi = 150
)
```

```{r load}
library(censusindia)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(scales)
```

```{r data}
districts <- census_2011_pca |>
  mutate(
    sc_pct = 100 * sc_population / population,
    st_pct = 100 * st_population / population
  )

boundaries <- get_census_boundaries(2011, "district")
state_bounds <- get_census_boundaries(2011, "state")
map_df <- attach_geometry(districts, 2011, geography = "district")
```

```{r map-population}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = boundaries, fill = "grey80", color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.03) +
  geom_sf(data = map_df, aes(fill = population), color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.05) +
  geom_sf(data = state_bounds, fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "viridis", direction = 1, begin = 0.1, end = 0.9,
    name = "Population", labels = label_comma(), trans = "log10",
    na.value = "grey70"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "District population (Census 2011)",
    subtitle = "Log scale. Thane (MH) at 11 million, Dibang Valley (AR) at 8,000"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.15, 0.25)
  )
```

```{r map-sc}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = boundaries, fill = "grey80", color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.03) +
  geom_sf(data = map_df, aes(fill = sc_pct), color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.05) +
  geom_sf(data = state_bounds, fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1,
    name = "SC (%)", labels = label_number(suffix = "%"),
    na.value = "grey70"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Scheduled Caste population share (Census 2011)"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.15, 0.25)
  )
```

```{r map-st}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = boundaries, fill = "grey80", color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.03) +
  geom_sf(data = map_df, aes(fill = st_pct), color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.05) +
  geom_sf(data = state_bounds, fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette = "Greens", direction = 1,
    name = "ST (%)", labels = label_number(suffix = "%"),
    na.value = "grey70"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Scheduled Tribe population share (Census 2011)"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = c(0.15, 0.25)
  )
```

```{r table-top-bottom}
districts |>
  arrange(desc(population)) |>
  slice(c(1:10, (n() - 9):n())) |>
  mutate(
    rank = c(1:10, (nrow(districts) - 9):nrow(districts)),
    population = format(population, big.mark = ",")
  ) |>
  select(rank, district, state_name_harmonized, population) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Rank", "District", "State/UT", "Population"),
    caption = "Ten most and least populous districts (Census 2011)"
  )
```
